header.publisher: CareScout (Genworth) Cost of Care Survey 2025; incidence from HHS ASPE
lawRefs: CareScout 2025 Cost of Care Survey, national medians (press release 2026-03-02, https://investor.genworth.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1054)

HHS ASPE, Favreault & Dey, "Long-Term Services and Supports for Older Americans: Risks and Financing" (2015, revised Feb 2016), Table 2 (https://aspe.hhs.gov/reports/long-term-services-supports-older-americans-risks-financing-research-brief-0)
header.notes: Annual costs are the survey's headline national medians, cited as benchmarks (survey fielded July-November 2025): in-home non-medical caregiver $35/hour x 44 hours/week = $80,080; assisted living $6,200/month; nursing home semi-private $315/day, private $355/day. CareScout merged homemaker and home health aide into one "non-medical caregiver" category. stateFactor is empty (state tables were not copied; the app treats a missing state as 1.0). Incidence: ASPE projects that 42.0% of men and 52.1% of women turning 65 will use some paid LTSS, for an unconditional average of 0.7 / 1.3 years; avgYears here is conditional on any use (0.7/0.420 and 1.3/0.521). A newer ASPE/Urban study (Johnson, 2019) gives 38% / 55%. sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (this file without `header`, JSON.stringify with no whitespace).

flags.incidence.*.avgYears: derived (unconditional average years / probability of any paid use); ASPE does not publish the conditional figure
flags.typicalOnsetAge: assumption; not from a cited source
flags.annualCost: third-party survey medians (benchmark, not law); taken from the press release, survey tables not copied
